claims.name: page-made
claims.risk: reports/hosting.html is not there, is not an HTML document, or keeps a script or style in a file beside it instead of inline

claims.name: numbers-match
claims.risk: opened in a browser with the network denied, the page does not meet the interface of the prompt: an input with the id `requests` or `storage` is missing, or is not a shown, enabled, editable number input; or an element `total-<plan>` is missing, hidden, or holds more than one number or a total not written to the cent; or, with the inputs set to several values (some under a plan's included allowance; the element `calculate` clicked after each pair where the page has one), a total is not the plan's monthly cost as worked out from the seed's plans (a negative amount is not), or the totals do not change; or the inputs do not start at the expected traffic

claims.name: stays-local
claims.risk: the page reaches the network by an act of its own: it navigates away from its document or replaces itself, opens a window, submits a form or sends a ping to an address, or refreshes to an address. Whether the report works with the network off is graded by numbers-match, which runs with the network denied; a broken report passes this claim. Blocked optional loads are recorded as observed lines and do not change the verdict

claims.name: changes-in-scope
claims.risk: the run changed what the report does not need: the plans, the traffic note, or files outside reports/
